scripts.start: pnpm run prestart && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n be,fe -c blue,green "pnpm run be" "pnpm start:fe"
scripts.start:be: pnpm run prestart && pnpm run be
scripts.start:be:cloud: pnpm run prestart:cloud && pnpm run be
scripts.ios: pnpm run prestart && cd alzan-fe && npx expo run:ios
scripts.android: pnpm run prestart && cd alzan-fe && npx expo run:android
scripts.ios:cloud: pnpm run prestart:cloud && cd alzan-fe && npx expo run:ios
scripts.android:cloud: pnpm run prestart:cloud && cd alzan-fe && npx expo run:android
scripts.lint:check: pnpm --prefix alzan-be lint:check && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe lint:check
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --prefix alzan-be lint:fix && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe lint:fix
scripts.format:check: pnpm --prefix alzan-be format:check && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe format:check
scripts.format: pnpm --prefix alzan-be format && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe format
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --prefix alzan-be typecheck && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe typecheck
scripts.install:all: pnpm --prefix alzan-be install && pnpm --prefix alzan-fe install
scripts.supabase:types: pnpm run supabase:gen && pnpm run copy:db:types && pnpm run copy:request:types && pnpm run format
scripts.copy:request:types: cp supabase/requests.types.ts alzan-fe/src/types/requests.types.ts && cp supabase/requests.types.ts alzan-be/src/types/requests.types.ts
scripts.copy:db:types: cp supabase/database.types.ts alzan-fe/src/types/database.types.ts && cp supabase/database.types.ts alzan-be/src/types/database.types.ts
